Interested candidates with strong inclination towards research and development may attend
walk-in interview proposed on 30th June, 2022 at 11 AM at Centre for Academics, CSJM
University Campus. The candidates should present themselves before the interview board with
all original documents, a copy of biodata and 3- sets of self- attested photocopies of all relevant
marksheets and certificates.
Note:
1. No TA/DA is admissible for appearance in the interview.
2. The terms and conditions for the appointment of Project assistants would be as per regulations
mentioned by UPHEC and CSJM University, Kanpur.
